packagesIntro: Kashmir, Rajasthan, islands, hills and heritage. Start with a ready plan, then adjust the pace, hotels or stops with our team.
storyHeading: India feels better when the details fit
storyParagraphs: If you live in India, you may have seen the same airport lounges and office roads for years. A short Goa break, a cool Kashmir escape, a temple-led Varanasi visit or a long road through Rajasthan can change that. We help you decide how many nights each place deserves and when a slower morning will save the day.

For visitors from abroad and NRIs, small details matter. Your private cab and driver follow the plan you agree on, hotels can be chosen from 3-star to 5-star options, and our team can explain the pace, food and local customs in simple language. You get room to ask questions before you arrive.

Tell us your dates, starting city and the places you care about. Comfort Journey, founded in Bhopal in 1992, shares a clear quote on WhatsApp and then refines the itinerary with you. If a famous stop feels too rushed, we can suggest a better order for the days you have.

quickAnswer.question: What do India tour packages usually include?
quickAnswer.answer: India tour packages usually include accommodation, planned sightseeing and transport, with the exact details changing by route. Comfort Journey can arrange a private cab with driver, hotel choices from 3-star to 5-star, and a custom itinerary. The team shares a clear quote on WhatsApp and remains available 24/7 during trips.

faqs.q: Can I customise an India tour package?
faqs.a: Yes. Every itinerary can be customised around your dates, destinations, hotel choice and daily pace. Tell the team what you want to keep, change or skip on WhatsApp.

faqs.q: Which Indian destinations can I visit?
faqs.a: The current collection includes Kashmir, Rajasthan, Goa, Andaman, Leh and Meghalaya, along with other regional routes. The team can help match a destination to your available days and interests.

faqs.q: Can you help foreign visitors and NRIs plan India?
faqs.a: Yes. Share your arrival city, dates, food preferences and the pace you prefer. Comfort Journey can explain the route, hotel choices, private cab arrangements and practical travel details in simple language.

faqs.q: What changes the price of an India tour?
faqs.a: The route, travel dates, number of nights, hotel category, vehicle plan and sightseeing choices all affect the price. Ask on WhatsApp for an exact quote based on your plan.

faqs.q: Will my India trip have a private car and driver?
faqs.a: Private cabs with drivers are available for India itineraries. Your quote will show the vehicle and transport details for the route you choose.

faqs.q: How do I book an India holiday package?
faqs.a: Send your dates, preferred places and group details on WhatsApp or call +91 92039 31912. The team will suggest suitable options, share the price upfront and help you confirm the plan.
